answer: Concretely, the economy can lock a compute bond for six epochs and slash it the moment two answers fingerprint-match. Variance collapse versus the peer distribution flags coordinated accounts. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, cluster rewards are paid once, not per address. The quill of work and the knoll of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a tundra to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
